name: Loris Degioanni
org: Politecnico di Torino (WinPcap); CACE Technologies (co-founder); Riverbed Technology; Sysdig (founder and CTO); Wireshark Foundation (board)
why_notable: Created WinPcap at the Politecnico di Torino, the Windows port of the BPF/libpcap capture architecture that let Ethereal, Wireshark, nmap and countless other tools capture packets on Windows for over a decade (later succeeded by Npcap). At CACE Technologies he hired Gerald Combs in 2006, and together they launched Wireshark under its new name; CACE was acquired by Riverbed in 2010. He then founded Sysdig, applying the same capture-and-filter idea to Linux system calls with the sysdig tool and the CNCF runtime-security project Falco, and Sysdig became Wireshark's lead sponsor before creating the independent Wireshark Foundation in 2023, on whose board he sits. Wireshark's sister tool Stratoshark, which analyses Falco system-call captures with Wireshark's engine, joins the two halves of his work.
